definitions: An item of dress or equipment that is carried or worn by a person but is not essential.
A person who helps another person to commit a crime.
Something added to a machine or to a musical instrument to make it more versatile, to improve its performance, or to provide it with an additional function.
examples: She wore a scarf as a fashion accessory.
He was charged as an accessory to the robbery.
The camera comes with several accessories.
